name: What are the financial implications of a 'Sell and Stay Program'?

mainEntity.name: What are the financial implications of a 'Sell and Stay Program'?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financially, you gain access to your home's equity upon closing, which can be used for your next purchase or other needs. You will then pay rent to the new owner for the agreed leaseback period, typically covering their mortgage, taxes, insurance, and potentially an additional premium. A key consideration is that while you gain liquidity, you will incur rental expenses for the duration of your stay. This represents a practical tradeoff between immediate capital access and ongoing housing costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: You access home equity post-sale but incur rental costs during your stay, balancing immediate capital with ongoing expenses.
